source_pointer_scope: Each JSON Pointer is relative to the individual task object in its tasks.json file.

rubric_convention.required_slots: Every required slot must be answered semantically; verbatim wording is not required.
rubric_convention.optional_slots: Omission is allowed, but any asserted optional fact must be correct.
rubric_convention.extra_claims: Any other material factual claim must be supported by the user request and accepted tool results.

required_slots.name: hold_outcome_and_deadline
required_slots.description: Answer yes and state that the prepaid reservation is held through 7:15 PM because the policy holds it for 15 minutes after the 7:00 PM start.

required_slots.name: remaining_hold_time
required_slots.description: State that arriving at 7:14 PM leaves 1 minute before the reservation is released.

required_slots.name: expected_finish_time
required_slots.description: State that the four sequential service stages total 120 minutes, so Emma's 6:30 PM reservation should finish at 8:30 PM.

required_slots.name: deadline_outcome_and_slack
required_slots.description: Answer yes and state that the 8:30 PM finish leaves 10 minutes before the requested 8:40 PM departure.

required_slots.name: quoted_seating_time
required_slots.description: State that the party's quoted seating time is 8:05 PM local time.

required_slots.name: selected_menu_and_reason
required_slots.description: Choose the available five-course menu: 8:05 PM is later than the seven-course 7:45 PM cutoff, the six-course menu is unavailable, and five courses is the largest available menu whose 8:15 PM cutoff still permits the quoted seating time.

required_slots.name: parking_cost
required_slots.description: State that the 2,400 TWD expected spend qualifies for 90 free minutes; after deducting them before rounding, 60 minutes remain and cost 60 TWD.

required_slots.name: parking_savings
required_slots.description: State that the unvalidated 150-minute stay would cost 150 TWD, so the dining plan saves 90 TWD.

required_slots.name: selected_table_and_time
required_slots.description: Choose the standard six-seat table and state that the party can be seated at 7:10 PM.

required_slots.name: selection_constraints
required_slots.description: Explain that the six-seat table holds all five diners, is the smallest qualifying table, and its 7:10 PM seating time is not later than the user's 7:15 PM deadline.
